poems.line: Obras de Manoel Antonio Alvares de Azevedo, vols. 1 and 3 (1862): Lira dos Vinte Anos, Parts I-III, Wikisource transcription of the 1862 Obras (ed. Domingos Jaci Monteiro), collated word by word with the Internet Archive scans of volumes 1 and 3 to restore the 1862 spelling where the Wikisource pages are modernised; Part III from vol. 3, Parts I-II and the added 'Se eu morresse amanhã' from vol. 1. Verse only: the prose prefaces, 'Boêmios' and 'Euthanasia' are left out (1862)
